Hands-On Lab

Create Custom Agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio

Build your first AI agent from scratch — add knowledge sources, connect tools, and test it live. By the end, you'll have a working agent that answers questions and sends emails.

🕓 ~50 minutes (+ 20 min bonus)
📚 Beginner Level
⚡ Prerequisites: Personal dev environment
Required

Pre-Lab Setup

Complete these steps before starting Exercise 1:

  1. Turn off the "New experience" toggle.
    In Copilot Studio, locate the New experience toggle in the top-right corner of the screen and ensure it is switched OFF (toggled to the left / grayed out). This lab uses the classic authoring experience.
Important: If the "New experience" toggle is left ON, the UI will not match the screenshots and instructions in this lab. Make sure it is turned OFF before proceeding.

Exercise 1: Create Your Agent

~15 min
1

Open Copilot Studio

Browse to Copilot Studio using your preferred browser:

URL
https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com
2

Select Your Environment

Click the Environment switcher in the global navigation bar to review all Power Platform environments you have access to.

Select your personal development environment (LAST NAME, FIRST NAME) from the list.

3

Create a New Agent

Select Home from the left-hand toolbar and click Create an agent in the middle of the screen.

Tip: It may take a moment for the agent to be provisioned. Wait for the green confirmation message before proceeding.
4

Configure Agent Details

In the Details section, click Edit:

Enter the following and click Save:

  • Name: Medical Records Agent (add something unique — e.g., your initials)
  • Description:
Description
You are an agent that assists with email requests from patients to answer questions regarding how to transfer their medical records from your office to another provider.
5

Add Instructions

Scroll to the Instructions section and click Edit:

Paste the following and click Save:

Instructions
You are part of our Nursing Staff, and you have a friendly and helpful tone. You will analyze the company policies to provide accurate advice to patients on how to submit a request to transfer their medical records.
6

Add a Knowledge Source

Scroll down to add Knowledge to the agent. Select Files as your knowledge source and upload the provided policy document.

  • Upload the MedicalRecordsPolicy.docx file provided to you
  • Update the Name: Medical Records Policy
  • Update the Description: This knowledge source outlines the medical records policies to follow.
  • Click Add to Agent
🚀 Stretch Goal — Use SharePoint Instead

If you'd like to connect to a live SharePoint document instead of uploading a file:

  1. Select SharePoint as your knowledge source (instead of Files)
  2. Paste the SharePoint URL to your policy document
  3. Click Add, then update the Name and Description as above

This is useful when your organization keeps documents in SharePoint that update over time — your agent will always use the latest version.

7

Configure Agent Settings

Click Settings in the top-right corner of your agent:

  • Make sure Generative AI orchestration is enabled:
  • Scroll down and turn off "Use General Knowledge":

Click Save.

Why disable General Knowledge? This tells the agent to answer only from the knowledge sources you provide — not from its underlying AI model's training data. For business scenarios, you want grounded, accurate answers from your own documents.

Click the X to close the Settings dialog.

8

Test Your Agent

Open the Test pane and click Refresh to load the latest config. Try these prompts:

Test Prompts
Can I transfer my medical records?
Is there a fee to transfer my records?
How long before I can expect my request to be complete?
What information is needed from me to transfer my medical records?
Observe the Activity Map: As you chat, the main canvas dynamically tracks the conversation flow and shows which Knowledge sources are being used to generate each response.
Checkpoint: Your agent should be answering questions using only the medical records policy document. If it's working, mark this step complete and move on!

Exercise 2: Add a Tool — Email the Patient

~15 min
1

Add the Email Tool

Navigate to the Overview tab, scroll down to the Tools section, and click Add Tool.

Search for Send an email V2 and select the Office 365 Outlook — Send an email (V2) action.

Careful! Do not select the Outlook.com version — it has the same name but will not work with organizational accounts.
2

Configure the Connection

You may be prompted to use an existing connection or create a new one.

  • If no connection exists, select Create a new connection and click Create
  • Once a connection exists, make sure it's selected and click Add and Configure
3

Configure Tool Settings

Fill in the following:

  • Name: Send an email
  • Description: This operation sends an email message to the patient to tell them how to submit a request to transfer their medical records from my office to their new provider.
  • Under Additional Details, change "Credentials to use" to Maker-provided credentials
  • In Subject, choose Custom Value and enter:
Email Subject
MY FIRST CUSTOM AGENT LAB WITH MICROSOFT
  • In the Completion section, set "After Running" to Send Specific response
  • Enter the message:
Completion Message
We have sent an email with this information!

Click Save.

4

Update Agent Instructions

Go to Overview → Instructions → Edit. At the end of your existing instructions, paste:

Additional Instructions
When asked to email information:

1. If the request to send an email originates in chat, ASK FOR THE EMAIL ADDRESS to send the email to and NEVER send it to the authenticated user's email address.
2. Use the [REPLACE THIS WITH YOUR ACTION] action to write an HTML email response advising how to submit a request to transfer their medical records only if asked to send an email in chat or if the action is triggered by an incoming email request.

Email Formatting
Always start with, "Hey, this is my first lab building a level 2 agent with Microsoft Copilot Studio! This is a sample message sent from my agent." Next, provide a description of what this agent does. But in chat, just provide the answer with citations. Do not include any citations in the email.

Click Save.

5

Link the Action in Your Instructions

Go back into the Instructions editor. Find [REPLACE THIS WITH YOUR ACTION], highlight it, type a forward slash /, and select your Send an Email action from the popup.

What's happening: The / command links a tool directly into instructions so the agent knows which action to invoke. This connects "what to do" with "how to do it."
6

Test the Email Tool

Open the Test pane, start a new session, and try this conversation:

  1. Ask: "Can I transfer my medical records?"
  2. After the response, ask: "email the information"
  3. When prompted, enter the email address you'd like to receive the test email at
  4. Check your inbox — you should receive an HTML-formatted email from your agent!
Congratulations! You've built an AI agent that answers questions from a knowledge source AND takes action by sending emails. 🎉

Bonus: Make Your Agent Autonomous Optional

~20 min

Finished early? Extend your agent to automatically respond to incoming emails — no human in the loop.

1

Add an Email Trigger

Go to Overview → Triggers → Add.

Search for When a new email arrives and select When a new email arrives (V3) from Office 365 Outlook.

2

Configure the Trigger

  • Name: When a new email arrives – Transfer Medical Records
  • Verify the connection is signed in (green checkmark)
  • Click Next
  • Enter the recipient email address to monitor in the "To" field
  • Enter a Subject filter:
Subject Filter
Transfer Medical Records

Click Create Trigger, then Close.

Tip: Use a subject that won't match your regular inbox traffic. Something specific like "Transfer Medical Records" ensures the trigger only fires for relevant emails.
3

Update Instructions for Autonomous Mode

Your agent now needs to handle two modes: conversational (chat) and autonomous (email trigger). Go to Overview → Instructions → Edit. Replace the entire instructions with:

Updated Instructions (Full Replacement)
You are part of our Nursing Staff, and you have a friendly and helpful tone. You should follow the steps below without missing any. Once all actions are completed your work is finished.

When you receive a new email with the subject line "Transfer Medical Records" perform the following tasks without asking the user for information. Make sure you remember who the email is from as that should be used in the [REPLACE WITH YOUR ACTION] action when required.

1. Search your internal knowledge base information on policies.
2. Answer each question based on the knowledge base you received.
3. Use the action [REPLACE WITH YOUR EMAIL ACTION] to write an HTML email response to the patient advising how to submit a request to transfer their medical records only if asked to send an email in chat or if the action is triggered by an incoming email request.
4. If the request to send an email originates in chat, ALWAYS ASK FOR THE EMAIL ADDRESS to send the email to. NEVER send it to the authenticated user's email address.
5. If the need to send an email is triggered automatically, send a reply to the email address that originally sent the email requesting the need to share or transfer medical records.

Email Formatting Always provide a short explanation of the decision and include any applicable fees and privacy concerns. Please also suggest they can call our customer service department at 555-123-4567. Use a friendly sign off as "Contoso Healthcare Service". But in chat, just provide the answer with citations. Do not include any citations in the email.

After pasting, highlight each [REPLACE WITH YOUR ACTION] and [REPLACE WITH YOUR EMAIL ACTION] placeholder, type /, and select your Send an Email action.

Click Save.

4

Publish Your Agent

Click Publish in the top-right corner. Review and click Publish again.

Why publish? Autonomous triggers only work on published agents. The Test pane uses draft mode, but email triggers run against the published version.
5

Test the Autonomous Agent

Send a test email to the recipient address you configured:

  • Subject: Transfer Medical Records
  • Body: How do I transfer my medical records to my new doctor?

Give your agent a few minutes. You should receive a response email!

Important: The trigger is now live in your environment! It will continue running until you turn it off. To disable: open the trigger in Power Automate and turn it off, or delete it from Copilot Studio. Do not leave triggers running unattended.
Amazing work! You've built a fully autonomous AI agent that monitors email and responds without human intervention. 🌟
